projects.title: Wakil AI
projects.subtitle: Bilingual Legal AI for Nepal
projects.description: Sophisticated legal RAG pipeline combining Qdrant vector search, BM25, and a Knowledge Graph to provide accurate legal citations for Nepali law. Integrates Gemini for real-time voice consultation via LiveKit.
features: Hybrid search (Vector + Keyword) for high-precision legal retrieval
Bilingual support for Nepali and English legal documents
Knowledge Graph for mapping legal relationships
projects.highlights: Most comprehensive AI legal assistant for Nepal — processing hundreds of legal documents with verifiable citations.

projects.title: VibeVolume
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Voice AI Agent
projects.description: Low-latency voice-to-voice pipeline implementing the STT → LLM → TTS flow. Built with Pipecat for orchestration, Deepgram for lightning-fast transcription, and XTTS for emotive voice synthesis.
features: Human-like emotive voice synthesis via XTTS
Scalable pipeline for autonomous AI voice agents
projects.highlights: Achieved near-human conversational latency, enabling fluid real-time AI interactions.

projects.title: Jarvis
projects.subtitle: Gemini Live Voice Bridge → Hermes
projects.description: Raw WebSocket bridge connecting Gemini Live API (gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview) to Hermes Agent. Handles OAuth-based bidirectional audio streaming, session management, reconnection with exponential backoff, and graceful turn completion.
features: Bidirectional real-time audio streaming with Gemini Live
OAuth token authentication (no AI Studio key required)
Keepalive heartbeat for idle connection maintenance
projects.highlights: Engineered a production-grade real-time voice bridge between Google's Gemini Live API and a local agent framework.

projects.title: Sahayogi
projects.subtitle: Skill Bartering Platform
projects.description: Community-driven marketplace where users exchange skills instead of money. Features a robust matching system to connect people with complementary needs and offerings.
features: Intuitive dashboard for managing skill exchanges
projects.highlights: Promoting a collaborative economy through an intuitive, full-stack skill-sharing ecosystem.

projects.title: KaamParyo
projects.subtitle: Hyperlocal Real-Time Task Marketplace
projects.description: Live GPS tracking (GalliMaps), real-time chat (Socket.IO), OTP auth, escrow payments, hot zones & rewards. 20+ REST endpoints, Redis session mgmt, geospatial queries, serverless deployment on Vercel.
features: Live GPS tracking with GalliMaps integration
projects.highlights: Built Nepal's first hyperlocal real-time task marketplace with GPS tracking and Socket.IO

projects.title: Bahun-D-Run
projects.subtitle: 3D Endless Runner (Unity, Android)
projects.description: Curved world, 3-lane movement, jump/slide, power-ups; 60+ FPS with object pooling & floating origin. Procedural track generation, physics-based controller, animation state machine.
features: Curved world mechanics with dynamic visual effects
projects.highlights: Shipped a mobile-optimized 3D Unity game with procedural systems and performance tuning

features: Admin CMS with secure JWT authentication
Photo Gallery with Cloudinary image uploads
Responsive design for mobile and desktop
projects.highlights: Full-stack school platform with CMS, CI/CD pipeline, and cloud asset management
